messages:
lucy: Heads-up: I reproduced a streaming jitter/duplication issue in the React sample when tokens refresh mid-stream. The UI shows chunks repeated and occasionally the end of one message shows up before the start of the next.
omar: is this the same as the earlier parse-on-abort bug or something new? browser only?
lucy: browser only. repro steps: boot sample -> open chat stream -> wait for short-lived dev token to expire -> automatic refresh happens -> stream reconnects. Sometimes you get a "...ing" tail + then the new message start, or words duplicated.
tia: can you share network logs / raw SSE payload? that helps rule out server reorder.
lucy: pasted minimal packet sequence (trimmed):
```
: keep-alive
data: {"chunk":"...verbi

"}
id: 800

: keep-alive
data: {"chunk":"ation and new st

"}
```
omar: OK this looks like two partial data frames that got split. The bug might be client-side: our ReadableStream pump hands slices to the SSE parser; on reconnect the parser state isn't invalidated so leftover partial data may be applied to the new connection.
qa-bot: QA:streaming-interop flaky test failing 3/10 runs on auth-reconnect scenario.
tia: Node SDK uses eventsource which merges byte boundaries differently so parity failures make sense.
lucy: I also noticed the sample's fallback polyfill (fetch->eventsource shim) reuses the same parser instance which will definitely carry state across reconnects. Bad for onboarding.
omar: Proposed fix: attach a streamEpoch id to each connection; parser ignores incoming data if epoch mismatches. Also on reconnect explicitly reset the parser state and consume any queued bytes that belong to the old epoch.
tia: agree. Add a short debounce on reconnect to allow in-flight chunks to drain and avoid immediate reopen. That should reduce overlap.
lucy: small UX thing: sample currently logs a bunch of reconnection lines. New users think the stream is broken. Change to a single-line transient UI banner like "reconnecting (auth)" with a small spinner.
omar: I'll implement epoch gating + parser.reset() in the browser sample. I'll also add an e2e that simulates mid-stream 401 and asserts no duplicate tokens are emitted.
qa-bot: CI: streaming-interop tests queued after fix branch push.
build-bot: staging deploy for bundle-3220 scheduled (includes devex/sse-epoch-fix). ETA 10m.
lucy: thanks. after deploy I'll re-run the repro with devtools + HAR and paste logs. Also add a note in onboarding: "If you see duplicated fragments, ensure you don't reuse parser instances across reconnects and avoid fetch polyfills that re-chunk streams."
omar: good doc note. tagging @tia for node parity test additions.
tia: will add node test and adjust eventsource parsing to treat connection boundaries as reset points.
lucy: excellent. follow-up ticket: add metrics for reconnection events per user so we can detect noisy clients.
omar: filed RD-1492. closing here, will open PR shortly.
